answer: Resist sybils with a Pulse Audit Lottery. First, every agent emits a signed pulse after each job, a public heartbeat of real work. Second, each epoch a random five percent are drawn for a live audit and must finish a fresh paid task in two hours under peer watch. Third, anyone who fails or misses it is frozen at the vertex of the trust graph and returns only after thirty days. Forging ten thousand fakes needs ten thousand real tasks per epoch plus 20,000 auditor-hours, over $1.8 million monthly. Like a sparrow that must sing daily to keep its nest, an idle identity loses its perch.
